concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-address-create-node]] - Node.js Vault address creation with required customer association, gateway-generated customer-scoped address IDs, the 50-address-per-customer limit, callback example, and not-found error route
warnings: Preserve that address IDs are unique to a customer, not globally unique; multiple customers can have the same address ID.
Keep creation separate from address update and deletion, and do not infer behavior for either neighboring operation.
Treat the linked Address response object, alternative creation pages, and exceptions page as navigation only unless each is fully read; do not add their semantics to this source.
